findings.location: Increment A — Affected areas and Steps 1–3
findings.problem: The plan does not change `capture_arxiv.py`, even though its metadata parser writes the arXiv title directly into each version's `source` record before `Store.create_book`/`set_metadata` copy a sanitized value to the root file. Thus an arXiv title containing marker words remains stored unchecked in `version.json`, contradicting the stated goal and the first identified hole.
findings.suggestion: Include `engine/kb/capture_arxiv.py` and its tests in Increment A; apply the shared title rule when constructing the arXiv source metadata (while preserving the intended empty-title behavior), and verify the version source record as well as the root metadata.

summary: The plan now covers the previously identified documentation and whole-index scope issues, but still leaves the original unchecked arXiv title stored in version metadata.
